# SCMP: China vows to ramp up west-to-east power output

Published: 3 Jan 2026. By Sylvia Ma.

## Key Findings
- China aims to expand west-to-east power transmission network to **>420 GW by 2030**.
- Target: increase renewables share to **~30% of total electricity output**.
- Add **~40 GW of interprovincial transfer capacity** by 2030.
- West-to-east transmission estimated at **>340 GW by end 2025**, up 25% from 270 GW at end of 13th FYP (per People's Daily, Oct 2025).
- Grid capacity to accommodate **900 GW of distributed renewables** by 2030.
- Support **>40 million charging stations** by 2030.
- Targets outlined in guidelines by NDRC + National Energy Administration.
- Context: Beijing stepping up energy security amid rising demand from AI and hi-tech manufacturing.
